findings.title: Unrelated pytest failure under root runner
findings.evidence: 04-gate.txt lines 79-100: test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused DID NOT RAISE Refused; chmod 0o500 has no effect for root (pytest tmp path /tmp/pytest-of-root); diff is a single markdown file
findings.consequence: Manifest result reads failed although the phase verification (src.governance) passed; the failure is not attributable to this diff
findings.minimal_fix: None for this phase; separately skip that test when running as root
